statement: Median fill size differs between BTC and ETH windows. (FORMAT EXAMPLE only.)

bootstrap._note: Where a group exceeds the cap, each resample is drawn at the cap rather than at n. The interval is then wider than a full-size bootstrap would give -- conservative, not optimistic. Each group reports the size actually used.

comparison._note: p-value is reported only alongside the effect size and n. A CI spanning zero is INDETERMINATE, never SUPPORTED, whatever the p-value.

ledger.note: 2 hypotheses have now been tested against this one corpus. A naive 0.05 threshold expects ~0.1 false positives at this count; a Bonferroni-adjusted threshold is 0.02500.
